response: SELECT `Channel`, SUM(`Line Total`) AS total FROM sales_order GROUP BY `Channel`;

user_input: Who are the top 5 customers by total line total? Show the customer name and the total.
response: SELECT c.`Customer Names` AS customer_name, SUM(so.`Line Total`) AS total FROM sales_order so JOIN customers c ON so.`Customer Name Index` = c.`Customer Index` GROUP BY c.`Customer Names` ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;
reference: SELECT c.`Customer Names`, SUM(s.`Line Total`) FROM sales_order s JOIN customers c ON s.`Customer Name Index` = c.`Customer Index` GROUP BY c.`Customer Names` ORDER BY SUM(s.`Line Total`) DESC LIMIT 5;

user_input: Which product has the highest total order quantity? Show the product name and the total quantity.
response: SELECT p.`Product Name`, SUM(s.`Order Quantity`) AS total_quantity FROM sales_order s JOIN products p ON s.`Product Description Index` = p.`Index` GROUP BY p.`Product Name` ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1;
reference: SELECT p.`Product Name`, SUM(s.`Order Quantity`) FROM sales_order s JOIN products p ON s.`Product Description Index` = p.`Index` GROUP BY p.`Product Name` ORDER BY SUM(s.`Order Quantity`) DESC LIMIT 1;

user_input: Which 3 states have the highest total population in the regions table? Show the state and the total population.
response: SELECT state, SUM(population) AS total_population FROM regions GROUP BY state ORDER BY total_population DESC LIMIT 3;
reference: SELECT state, SUM(population) FROM regions GROUP BY state ORDER BY SUM(population) DESC LIMIT 3;
